preconditions.description: The first line contains an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 2·10^5), and the second line contains exactly n integers a_1, a_2, ..., a_n (0 ≤ a_i < n).

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(a) < n for a in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: Each a_i in the input sequence satisfies 0 ≤ a_i < n.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'Possible' and len(stdout.splitlines()) == 2 and all(1 <= int(x) <= n for x in stdout.splitlines()[1].split()) and len(set(stdout.splitlines()[1].split())) == n
postconditions.description: If a valid order exists, the first line of stdout is 'Possible', and the second line is a permutation of student indices (1 to n) representing a valid arrival order.
If no valid order exists, stdout is exactly 'Impossible'.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= a_i < len(present_before) for a_i in a) if 'Possible' in stdout else True
postconditions.description: For each student i in the output permutation, a_i equals the number of students present before i who are not part of any team at the time of i's arrival. Here, 'present_before' is the set of students who arrived before i and are not in any team formed before i's arrival.

postconditions.expression: all(len(teams) * 3 <= n for teams in possible_teams) if 'Possible' in stdout else True
postconditions.description: The total number of students in all teams (each team has exactly 3 students) does not exceed n, and no student is in more than one team.

postconditions.expression: all(team_members not in [x for x in permutation if permutation.index(x) > permutation.index(i)] for i in permutation for team_members in possible_teams)
postconditions.description: For each student i, if they are part of a team, all team members must have arrived before i or at the same time as i (but teams are formed immediately upon arrival of the third member).
